findings.summary: test_map_jvp_matches_central_difference has no non-triviality guard on the tangent, so a map that became constant returns tangent_value=0 and finite=0, and error computes 0/max(0,1e-300)=0 which passes error<1e-6; the sibling boundary-flux test guards this at line 341 with abs(finite)>0. Add the same guard so a degenerate map reddens the test.

the six row assertions read _receipt_rows() from the committed fragment JSON rather than measuring, so a regression in the map code leaves them green because the fragment is static; only the driver main() at line 399 re-measures, and pytest never runs it. The fidelity guard therefore catches a corrupt or out-of-bound receipt but not a code regression.

_carrier and _measure_map re-implement the map/booking/closure measurement already owned by tests/test_certificate_exterior_support.py:59 _arm_measurement, roughly 45 percent of their lines identical with the same field names and formulas, instead of extending that owner with a case parameter; the two recipes will drift apart on the next fixture change.

the figure draws each panel with only its own null set, but nova AGENTS.md 'Plotting rules' and every comparable evidence fragment draw BOTH the solved and analytic null sets with a caption distinction, since a solved null drawn alone on a non-converged state reads as the answer; the caption's note that each panel carries its own null set is honest, but the two sets are never shown together.
